div.head: CHn cor Epil.
div.ab: Testibus: M. Londoniae episcopo, et Gundulfo episcopo et Willelmo, electo episcopo, et Henrico comite et Simone comite et Waltero Giffardo et Rodberto de Monfort et Rogero Bigoto et Henrico de Portu. Apud [Westmonasterium] quando fui coronatus.

Witnesses: M[aurice], Bishop of London, and Bishop Gundulf and William, Bishop elect, and Earl Henry and Earl Simon and Walter Giffard and Robert de Montfort and Roger Bigot and Henry de Port. At Westminster when I was crowned.
div.note: Added October 2026 from Robertson pp. 282–283 (text and translation); Liebermann’s text (K–M) not yet added; [Westmonasterium]: Londoniam H, R1 (Robertson).
